title: Melinda R NDE 3207
content: I saw the hospital room that I was in (emergency room department). I did not want to come back, but eventually understood that I had to. Not sure how I knew that, but later, after I recuperated, I remember knowing that I would never be afraid of dying. I also, at eighteen, was very sure I had to do something for other people with my life. I tried to convince my parents that I HAD to join the Peace Corps; something I would have never wanted to do before this happened. It totally changed my life. My mother died two years ago. I was with her when the doctor told her she had a month to live, and was able to tell her that I was SURE she would be okay.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Head on auto collision Life threatening event, but not clinical death 'not sure if clinical death or not; would have to get records. very close, comatose for one week'
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Vision of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal All of it; but I remember the last part all these years later!!
elements.At what time during the experience were: All of it; but I remember the last part all these years later!!
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I was there a long time, to me, but it was not actually long at all.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I saw something like a tunnel, but was very aware of the peaceful light at the end.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I did, but cannot describe them. I 'knew' they were there, and communicated without words.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was a light; but so much more. Almost like a living light.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future My daughter.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes My religious beliefs changed to become much more expansive, less narrow.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes My religious beliefs changed to become much more expansive, less narrow.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I know that death is just not something to fear. Also, that we are supposed to be helping each other, as a society.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I know that death is just not something to fear. Also, that we are supposed to be helping each other, as a society.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The feeling - this was before people spoke about this like they do now!
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I told my family as soon as possible. They had not heard of this, and just shrugged it off to drugs. However, I don't think I would have been on the drugs in the emergency room, at least not right away.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: My experience was a long time ago, but it still affects my life today.
